record.original_question: For a fixed prime p and any real number theta, must one always have lim inf_{q -> +infty} q |q|_p ||q theta|| = 0? Equivalently, for irrational theta, is it true or false that inf_{n,q in Z_+} q ||p^n q theta|| = 0?

evidence.quote: De Mathan and Teulié conjectured [93] that for any θ ∈ R one has lim inf q|q|p ||qθ|| = 0.
The conjecture can be reformulated as follows: to prove or to disprove that for irrational θ one has inf q||pn qθ|| = 0.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix a prime number $p$. For an integer $q$, write $|q|_p$ for the $p$-adic absolute value of $q$ (with $|0|_p=0$ by convention), and for a real number $x$ write $\|x\|=\min_{n\in\mathbb{Z}}|x-n|$ for the distance from $x$ to the nearest integer. The question is: for every real number $\theta$, must one have
$$\liminf_{q\to+\infty} q\,|q|_p\,\|q\theta\| \;=\; 0\,?$$
Equivalently, is it true or false that for every irrational $\theta\in\mathbb{R}$ one has
$$\inf_{n,q\in\mathbb{Z}_{+}} q\,\|p^{n}q\theta\| \;=\; 0\,?$$
Decide whether this assertion holds.
artifact.status_search_result: The p-adic Littlewood conjecture of de Mathan and Teulié remains open. Recent work studies function-field analogues: the t-adic Littlewood conjecture over $\mathbb{F}_q(t)$ has been investigated, with counterexamples found to the polynomial $p(t)$-adic analogue over small finite fields (characteristics 3 and 5), but no resolution of the original $p$-adic conjecture over $\mathbb{R}$ is known.

status_evidence.title: On the t-adic Littlewood Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: The p-adic Littlewood conjecture due to de Mathan and Teulié asserts that for any prime p and any real α, inf |m||m|_p ||mα|| = 0. This still open conjecture stands as a variant of the Littlewood conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The p-adic Littlewood conjecture is still open.

status_evidence.title: Counterexamples to the p(t)-adic Littlewood Conjecture Over Small Finite Fields
status_evidence.snippet: Explicit counterexamples are constructed to the p(t)-adic Littlewood conjecture over finite fields of small characteristic.
status_evidence.claim: Function field analogues have counterexamples, but the original p-adic conjecture remains open.

status_evidence.title: On the complexity of a putative counterexample to the p-adic Littlewood conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Studies properties any potential counterexample to the p-adic Littlewood conjecture would need to satisfy.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is still open and counterexamples are only hypothesized.
